conflicts.explanation: Underground power cable (proposed, Power Utility, 25 Oct–5 Nov) and Water main replacement (P02, Water Board, 3–20 Nov) both cover Lakeview Rd 800–1000 m (200 m). Their dates overlap for 3 days (3–5 Nov). Possible coordination conflict, flagged for review; not a finding of fault.
conflicts.suggestedAction: Coordinate the two departments: align to one window so both use one trench and one road closure.
